sources.title: Columbus Roofing & Exterior Pros | Coldstream Exteriors
sources.description: Learn about Coldstream Exteriors in Columbus, OH. Trusted local roofing, siding, windows & gutters experts with A+ BBB rating and 20+ years experience.

blocks.text: From flipping houses to fund his college education to founding Coldstream Exteriors, Jon Davis has turned his passion for transforming homes into a lifelong mission in Cincinnati. With 17 years in residential construction, Jon’s love for instant transformation drives him to create those “wow” moments that happen when a home gets a fresh new look. A lifelong Cincinnati resident, he’s built Coldstream Exteriors on the cornerstones of faith, family, and exceptional craftsmanship – values that shine through in everything from their Ronald McDonald House volunteer work to the way they treat each customer’s home. When he’s not helping his team master the latest industry innovations or perfecting a client’s siding project, you might find Jon on the golf course, where he says the game teaches him the same patience and strategic thinking that helps him lead Coldstream Exteriors to new heights.

Growing up alongside his father tackling home projects, Tyler Brooks learned early on that there’s something special about completing a project with your own hands. Now leading Coldstream Exteriors’ Columbus location, he brings that same hands-on dedication and “do right” philosophy from his days coaching high school baseball to every home renovation project. Recently making Columbus his home in 2024, Tyler has already fallen in love with the city’s vibrant energy and growing communities, seeing endless possibilities in the booming housing market. When he’s not helping transform homes with stunning siding projects or giving back through Children’s Hospital initiatives, you might find Tyler on a local golf course learning patience from the game’s challenges, or exploring Columbus’s neighborhoods with his family and their dogs – adventures that he says keep him grounded in what matters most: faith, family, and community service.

With over 25 years of experience, the team at Coldstream Exteriors can handle all of your home’s exterior construction needs. From roofing and siding to windows and gutters, our team has you covered. We offer a wide range of services, catering all projects to fit the needs and budgets of our clients. We love working with individuals looking to enhance their home and pride ourselves on delivering results our clients are proud of. We require no payments until project completion which takes away the risk of putting down a deposit and having a contractor not complete the work. Additionally, every Coldstream location is locally owned and operated and adhere to the highest quality and personnel standards in the industry.
